basic_details.job_title: DHFWS Birbhum Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 DEO, Ayush Doctor and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: AYUSH DOCTOR - AYURVIDYA, AYUSH DOCTOR - AYUSH Mobile Medical Unit (Birbhum), AYUSH DOCTOR For Mobility Management and disability Prevention of Lymphatic Filariasis and 2 more
basic_details.short_information: Birbhum District Health and Family Welfare Samity (Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health & Secretary, District Health and Family Welfare Samity, AYUSH Branch, Birbhum), Government of West Bengal, Suri, has invited applications for 7 posts in 5 roles under Advt No. 453 /DMO/AYUSH/ Birbhum. The posts include AYUSH DOCTOR - AYURVIDYA, AYUSH DOCTOR - AYUSH Mobile Medical Unit (Birbhum), AYUSH DOCTOR For Mobility Management and disability Prevention of Lymphatic Filariasis, Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW) and 1 more. The online application is open from 3 November 2026 to 17 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online only, through net banking or credit/debit card. Last date to pay the fee: 13 November 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below

qualification.education_qualification: AYUSH Doctor: Graduate degree in Homeopathy (BHMS) or Ayurveda (BAMS) as per post; MPW: Graduate with at least 1-year Diploma Course in Computer; DEO: Graduation in Computer Application/IT/BBA/BCA/B.Tech (CS/IT)/B.Sc-IT or graduation with one-year computer diploma/certificate, plus 1 year experience

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Graduate degree in Homeopathy (BHMS) from recognized university. Age limit: 21 to 50 years. Pay: Rs. 40000 month (consolidated). Qualification required: Graduate degree in Homeopathy (BHMS) from recognized university. Age limit: 21 to 50 years. Pay: Rs. 40000 month (consolidated). Qualification required: Graduate from any recognized university; At least 1-year Diploma Course in Computer (Including MS office, MS word, MS power point, MS Excel) from Govt. Registered institution. Age limit: 21 to 40 years. Pay: Rs. 15000 per month (consolidated). Qualification required: Graduation in Computer Application/IT/Business Admi

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 40,000 per month (AYUSH Doctor), Rs. 25,000 per month (DEO), Rs. 15,000 per month (MPW), consolidated

exam_pattern.details: Minimum 50% marks in computer test; otherwise candidature treated as cancelled

how_to_apply: Apply online in the prescribed format at www.wbhealth.gov.in, link On-line Recruitment, from 11 am of 03.11.2026.
Complete online registration and pay the fee by midnight of 13.11.2026.
Pay the fee online through net banking or credit/debit card; do not pay more than once.
After successful payment, finally submit the form using the application id received at registration by midnight of 17.11.2026.
Upload proper signature and photograph with the online application.
Download the printout from http://hr.wbhealth.gov.in Application Print and keep it for document verification; do not send it by post.

content_sections.heading: How Will Birbhum District Health and Family Welfare Samity Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting and merit list based on marks in educational qualification and experience Computer test where mandatory (minimum 50% marks) Interview (Data Entry Operator) Final selection on merit, computer test (where applicable) and experience AYUSH Doctor: BHMS/BAMS marks 85 (percentile) plus experience up to 15 marks; shortlisting as per 100 percent merit and experience AYUSH Doctor experience: 1 mark per completed year up to 5 years, 2 marks per completed year above 5 years, maximum 15 MPW: Graduation 75 marks, Computer Test (Practical) 15 marks with 50% minimum, Experience 10 marks (2 per year) DEO: Madhyamik 5, Class 12 5, Graduation 10, Post-Graduation 10, Experience 10, Computer Test 50, Interview 10 DEO: shortlisted for computer test; those qualifying with 50% appear for interview Marks are rounded off up to 2 decimal points

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Birbhum District Health and Family Welfare Samity Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 17 November 2026. Applications opened on 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Birbhum District Health and Family Welfare Samity Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies: 1 AYUSH DOCTOR - AYURVIDYA, 1 AYUSH DOCTOR - AYUSH Mobile Medical Unit (Birbhum), 1 AYUSH DOCTOR For Mobility Management and disability Prevention of Lymphatic Filariasis, 3 Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW), 1 DATA ENTRY OPERATOR (NAM, DPMU).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Birbhum District Health and Family Welfare Samity Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General: Rs. 100. Reserved category: Rs. 50.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - AYUSH DOCTOR - AYURVIDYA: 21 to 50 years; AYUSH DOCTOR - AYUSH Mobile Medical Unit (Birbhum): 21 to 50 years; AYUSH DOCTOR For Mobility Management and disability Prevention of Lymphatic Filariasis: 21 to 50 years; Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW): 21 to 40 years; DATA ENTRY OPERATOR (NAM, DPMU): 21 to 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 40000 month (consolidated) for AYUSH DOCTOR - AYURVIDYA, Rs. 40000 month (consolidated) for AYUSH DOCTOR - AYUSH Mobile Medical Unit (Birbhum), Rs. 40000 month (consolidated) for AYUSH DOCTOR For Mobility Management and disability Prevention of Lymphatic Filariasis, Rs. 15000 per month (consolidated) for Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW), Rs. 25000 Month for DATA ENTRY OPERATOR (NAM, DPMU).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: AYUSH Doctor: Graduate degree in Homeopathy (BHMS) or Ayurveda (BAMS) as per post; MPW: Graduate with at least 1-year Diploma Course in Computer; DEO: Graduation in Computer Application/IT/BBA/BCA/B.Tech (CS/IT)/B.Sc-IT or graduation with one-year computer diploma/certificate, plus 1 year experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal. Applicant must have knowledge of local languages. All essential criteria must be completed on or before the first date of online application.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates found ineligible at any stage will not be called for subsequent stages.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting and merit list based on marks in educational qualification and experience. Computer test where mandatory (minimum 50% marks). Interview (Data Entry Operator). Final selection on merit, computer test (where applicable) and experience.
